name: gitlab
description: Inspect GitLab projects, triage merge requests and issues, debug CI/CD, address review feedback, and publish changes.

interface.shortDescription: Triage MRs, issues, pipelines, and publish flows
interface.longDescription: Use GitLab to inspect projects, review merge requests, address threaded feedback, diagnose failing pipelines, manage repository content, and publish local changes through a connector-first workflow with local Git fallbacks.
defaultPrompt: Triage my open GitLab issues and merge requests.
Diagnose the failed jobs in my latest pipeline.
Review, commit, and publish my local changes as a draft merge request.
